mechanism.claim: A daily change in the official 2s5s10s Treasury butterfly isolates belly repricing from level and end-point slope moves. Rising belly curvature is intermediate-horizon discount-rate tightening and maps short BTC; falling curvature maps long BTC for one day when completed BTC variation is elevated.
mechanism.side: negative strict sign of the daily change in 2*5y-2y-10y
mechanism.why_distinct: TPYSR used the same-sign 2y/10y level factor and HVTCTR used only opposite-sign 2y/10y twists. HVTBCR introduces the official 5y belly and the three-point curvature factor; it reuses no event set or diagnostic control.

literature_context.yield_curve_factors: Litterman and Scheinkman (1991), Common Factors Affecting Bond Returns, DOI 10.3905/jfi.1991.692347: level, steepness and curvature are distinct factors
literature_context.bitcoin_monetary_policy: Kang, Ratti and Vespignani (2023), Monetary policy and Bitcoin, DOI 10.1016/j.jimonfin.2023.102880

mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed seven-day BTC realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: a sparse next-day official sovereign-belly curvature clock is absent from Gross9

features.source: hash-bound official US Treasury Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates XML
features.transition: consecutive valid Treasury observations one to five calendar days apart
features.curvature_change: current curvature minus immediately previous valid curvature
features.availability: source day D plus one calendar day at 12:00 UTC
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact completed 5m BTC close/open log returns over seven elapsed days ending at decision)
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 daily 12:00 UTC states, minimum 180; current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval and final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no source, maturity, curvature, side, variation, delay, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator or control repair
